top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks join the magic-wavelength many-atom principle to decisive experimental realization in a sharply bounded, independently reproducible precision instrument. Subject to final historical confirmation of the Katori-Ye allocation, this has the strongest combination of fundamental reach, maturity, and exact attribution.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict is apparent from the supplied profile. My long-standing collaboration with Anne L'Huillier concerns attosecond physics and does not concern any proposed configuration.
